title: Recovery Histories: Exact Passage Compression and Additive Choice
description: Archival release of the recovery-histories stage of the Rational Relapse Theory research program, originally labeled JET_Recovery_Histories_v25. The paper studies exact passage compression of target-relative adjustment histories, including a universal passage carrier, path fibers, balance and cancellation conditions, directed Stieltjes representation, and finite-data implications on a non-additively-closed history domain. The release includes the English historical manuscript and a Chinese archival translation preserving the theorem and label structure. Later archive versions substantially revise the primitives, terminology, and identification focus.
